selectionPolicy: Current source-checked updates first, then dated report coverage, then dated discovery records. Historical and overdue records are explicitly labeled; no old source URL makes a record current. This is a working 150-topic discovery selection, not a severity ranking. Internal platform operations are omitted from featured topics, not deleted.

updates.title: November election: counting and certification
updates.finding: Pueblo County has posted the November 13 unofficial results update: 69,917 voters out of 116,192 (60.17%). Selected local counts: 2A had 14,044 yes and 24,683 no; 2B had 23,671 yes and 15,392 no; library 6A had 39,173 yes and 26,654 no. Earlier returns remain historical snapshots, not final results.
updates.meaning: The latest published update is unofficial. More yes or no votes in this report is not a certified result or legal implementation date. Districtwide contests beyond Pueblo County require results from all applicable jurisdictions. Do not transfer officeholder authority without verifying the effective term.

sources.title: November 13 official-publisher unofficial results report, pp. 1, 5, 7, 16–18
County election timeline (published guidance; dates require current confirmation)

updates.milestone: County's published timeline lists November 24 for risk-limiting audit reporting and November 25 for canvass/official abstract; verify any changes. Certification and taking office are separate events.

updates.title: Pueblo County: 2027 budget process
updates.finding: The County's 2027 budget page provides a meeting calendar, preliminary proposed budget, proposed-budget presentation and financial outlook. No document was listed under its adopted budget heading in the page inspected.
updates.meaning: The preliminary proposal is not evidence of final spending authority, final staffing or an actual expense. The next decision may change amounts.

sources.title: County annual budgets and historical adopted budgets

updates.milestone: Track adoption, amendments and subsequent actuals; no document listing alone demonstrates a final Council or Board decision.

updates.title: City of Pueblo: 2027 proposed budget
updates.finding: The City Finance page lists its 2027 proposed budget alongside the annual budget, transparency portal, financial reports and economic-development reports.
updates.meaning: The 2026 adopted appropriation remains a historical authorization fact. The 2027 proposal is a distinct edition, not a final appropriation or a cash-spending report.
